info.title: Jaano Enterprise Developer API
info.description:
REST API v1 for Jaano AI voice agents, compliant outbound calling, leads and campaigns, phone numbers, revocable scoped API keys, and HMAC-signed post-call webhooks.

All requests authenticate with a workspace API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer jaano_live_...`. Errors use a common envelope with a `code` and a `request_id`.

BadRequest.description: The request is malformed or a required field is missing.

Unauthorized.description: The API key is missing, invalid, or revoked.

Forbidden.description: The API key lacks the required scope, or the plan does not include this feature.

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist in this workspace.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.

Gone.description: The resource was archived or deleted (for example lead_deleted, campaign_archived, agent_archived, transcript_expired).

ServiceUnavailable.description: A required upstream dependency is unavailable (for example dnd_lookup_failed when strict_dnd is true).

UnprocessableEntity.description: The request is valid but violates a business rule (for example trai_quiet_hours or dnd_registered).

RateLimited.description: Too many requests. See the Retry-After header.

InternalError.description: An unexpected server error occurred. Include request_id when contacting support.

Metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs echoed back in webhooks and reads.

api_key.description: The API key used for this request, or null for console sessions.

rate_limit_per_min.description: Optional per-key ceiling (requests/minute per endpoint class). null uses the default per-key share of the workspace limit.

metadata.description: Non-secret details such as key name, prefix, and scopes.

mode.description: Key mode. 'test' mints a sk_test_ key that never spends credits, places real calls, or sends WhatsApp messages.

rate_limit_per_min.description: Optional per-key ceiling for this key (requests/minute per endpoint class). Omit to use the default share of the workspace limit.

scopes.description: Scopes to grant. Omit or pass [] for full access (requires an admin caller). A key can only mint keys with scopes it already holds.

expires_at.description: Optional expiry. Omit for a non-expiring key.

default_bot_id.description: Optional default bot for agent creation.

api_key.description: The full secret. Shown only once.

grace_period_seconds.description: How long the old key keeps working after rotation (0 = revoke immediately, max 7 days).

first_message.example: Hi, this is Ananya calling from Acme Realty. Is this a good time?

bot_id.description: Optional. When omitted, the workspace's first bot is used, or one is created.

AgentUpdateRequest.description: Partial update. Only the fields you send are changed.

bot_created.description: True when a workspace bot was auto-created.

url.description: Short-lived S3 presigned URL. Present only when status is ready.

from_phone_number.description: Caller ID. Defaults to the agent's assigned number.

customer_name.description: Forwarded to the agent as dynamic_variables.lead_name.

lead_description.description: Forwarded to the agent as dynamic_variables.lead_desc.

dynamic_variables.description: Extra variables injected into the agent prompt.

strict_dnd.description: When true, returns 503 dnd_lookup_failed if the DND check is unavailable.

first_message.description: Overrides the agent's opening line for this call.

already_ended.description: True when the call had already ended.

carrier_warning.description: Present when the carrier hangup request failed.

agent_id.description: Present for inbound numbers with an active agent.

PhoneNumberReleaseRequest.description: Direction and region of the number to release. Query parameters with the same names are accepted as a fallback.

campaign_id.description: Optional. Must belong to this workspace.

agent_id.description: Optional. Must belong to this workspace.

bot_id.description: Optional. Must belong to this workspace.

variables.description: Flat key-value map. Max 50 primitive keys.

LeadUpdateRequest.description: Partial update. Only the fields you send are changed.

bot_id.description: Optional. Must belong to this workspace.

CampaignUpdateRequest.description: Partial update. Blocked with 409 campaign_in_progress while the campaign is running.

rejected.description: Rows that failed validation. The rest are still enrolled.

webhook_url.description: Must be a public HTTPS URL.

request_headers.description: Custom headers sent with each delivery.

webhook_secret.description: HMAC signing secret. Shown only once.

get.summary: Inspect API key identity, workspace, and scopes

get.description: Newest first. Covers created, rotated, revoked, and deleted events for this workspace's API keys. Secrets are never included.
Returns metadata only. Secrets are never returned after creation.

post.summary: Mint a scoped revocable API key (max 25 active per workspace)
post.description: The secret `api_key` is returned exactly once.

201.description: Replacement key created. Store api_key now.

post.description: Mints a replacement with the same name, scopes, default bot, IP allowlist and expiry, then retires the old key. The old key is revoked immediately unless `grace_period_seconds` is set, in which case it keeps working until the grace period ends. The new secret `api_key` is returned exactly once. The caller must already hold every scope of the key being rotated.

delete.summary: Revoke or permanently delete an API key
delete.description: Revokes an active API key immediately by default. Pass `permanent=true` to permanently delete an active, expired, or revoked key record from the workspace.

parameters.name: permanent
parameters.description: Set to true to permanently remove the key record instead of only revoking it.

post.description: `bot_id` is optional. When omitted, the workspace's first bot is used, or one is created automatically.

patch.summary: Update voice agent or attach a per-agent webhook

delete.description: Call and billing history are preserved. Later dials return 410 agent_archived.

Deactivate inbound DID routing for agent

200.description: Provisioning result. The response shape is carrier-specific and is delegated to the legacy phone controller; it is not yet modeled as a schema.

get.description: Filter by agent_id, status, or direction.

post.summary: Initiate an idempotent, compliance-gated outbound call
post.description: Send an `Idempotency-Key` header so retries never dial twice. Reusing a key with a different body returns 422 idempotency_key_reused. Calls pass wallet, TRAI quiet-hours, NDNC/DND, abuse-tier, and concurrency gates.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key for this request. Retrying with the same key and body returns the original response instead of dialing again.

get.summary: Get call status, billing, and recording

get.description: Returns 404 recording_not_ready until the carrier upload completes. Poll at about 1, 5, and 10 minutes after hangup, or subscribe to call_recording_ready.
Transcripts are kept for 90 days. After that the endpoint returns 410 transcript_expired.

post.summary: Hang up an active call and release its concurrency slot
post.description: Safe to retry. Calls that already ended return `already_ended: true`.

get.summary: List active leads for the workspace
get.description: Phone filters match on a hash, so the stored phone number is never compared in plaintext.

post.description: `campaign_id`, `agent_id`, and `bot_id` are optional and must belong to the workspace when provided.

patch.summary: Partially update lead fields or variables
patch.description: `variables` are merged into the existing map.

delete.description: Call history is preserved. Later reads return 410 lead_deleted.

get.summary: List active campaigns for the workspace

post.description: `bot_id` is optional and must belong to the workspace when provided.

patch.summary: Partially update a campaign that is not running

delete.description: Pending or running campaigns are cancelled first. Later reads return 410 campaign_archived.

post.summary: Bulk-enroll up to 500 leads into a campaign
post.description: Each row is validated on its own. Invalid rows are reported in `rejected`, and the valid rows are still enrolled.

post.summary: Cancel a pending or in-progress campaign

post.description: The `webhook_secret` is returned exactly once. Use it to verify the `Jaano-Signature` header.

Update webhook URL, events, headers, or status
